comment: Update Native Auth V2 sign-up to send username on start, remove upfront password input, require email verification before subsequent steps, and reject email as a profile attribute. [#8940](https://github.com/AzureAD/microsoft-authentication-library-for-js/pull/8940) Reuse the V1 sign-in input type for V2, disallow null V2 scopes, and reuse request-challenge results for code and MFA resend. [#8941](https://github.com/AzureAD/microsoft-authentication-library-for-js/pull/8941) Share the password-required state and password submission result between sign-in and sign-up, and add password-state narrowing. [#8942](https://github.com/AzureAD/microsoft-authentication-library-for-js/pull/8942) Follow server-directed multi-step sign-up attribute and password collection without retaining submitted values or re-verifying email after attribute submission.
